items.title: Bill Ackman: Netflix “an Incredibly Cheap Stock” After a 55% Drop. But Is He Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman called Netflix “an incredibly cheap stock” on CNBC’s Squawk Pod, after his fund sold out of most of its Alphabet stake and with Netflix down about 55% from its June 2025 high. Ackman says viewing hours are falling because Netflix’s content mix is changing, and Netflix’s churn improved year over year in the third quarter.
